create_ghost_walker: create a grey ghost reference walker in a MuJoCo arena with no contacts or actuators
extract_qpos_qvel: extract full qpos and qvel arrays from a dictionary of logged walker features
set_walker_pose: set a walker's freejoint and mocap joint positions and velocities in the physics model
set_props_pose: set multiple prop positions and quaternions from a features dictionary with optional z offset
get_walker_features: get a dictionary of walker features including position, quaternion, joints, velocity, and end effectors
